description: The total for one stay at one New Leaf property: the nights, the tax and what is paid at the property. Asks that property live and returns its quote, with source attribution on booking links, so the figure is the one its booking form uses, and passes on its refusal when a stay cannot be sold. Requires the property, room type and dates. It gives a price and does not establish room availability.

property.description: The property: its name, slug or domain, or a short name such as apollo (3 characters or more), in any case.

roomtype.description: single, double or studio. Also read from roomType, room_type, type or room.
